(Source: Paper Survey researched by Judith C. Walsh and published in Lynes, 1999.)

cr_data.provenance: Dorothy Schubart, New York, NY, gift, 1940 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. Dorothy Schubart was a niece by marriage of Stieglitz. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: Depicts Dorothy Schubart, a niece by marriage of Alfred Stieglitz. Schubart looks out towards the viewer wearing a neutral expression. The woman has her dark hair pinned up, partially covering her ears. The woman's head and neck are in shades of black, white, and gray and the portrait appears against a plain white background.
imageCaption: Courtesy of Museum of Modern Art (MoMA).
title: Untitled (Dorothy Schubart)
